launch_reuse.composition_rule: issue cycles = max(0.25 * total warp instructions, busiest pipe) per phase

l1.capacity_rule: largest one-block-per-SM footprint whose re-read pass ratio is at most hit_ratio + 0.25 * (1 - hit_ratio)

mlp.rule: per phase with global loads: read bytes / (active SMs x in-flight bytes per SM / service latency) is a lower bound on the stream stage; in-flight per SM = resident warps x (read bytes per load request) x min(loads per warp / dependent load depth, 1 or more)

overlap.overlap_definition: alpha = (Tm + Tc - T) / (Tm + Tc - max(Tm, Tc)); 0 = different blocks phases fully serialised, 1 = fully overlapped

smem.conflict_degree_rule: cost = max(floor, slope * degree), degree = largest number of distinct 32-bit words mapping to one of 32 banks per request group

note: All constants come from synthetic microbenchmarks (timing and energy windows); no operator kernel, application runtime or application energy value was read. Failed or missing stages are listed in `stages` and make `complete` false.
